problem: False in four ways. (1) raw_payload keeps the full statement row with no masking: the full description, any counterparty name or account columns, and for MT940 the full :25: account number. (3) Registered own accounts are stored with all their digits. (4) The masking in bank_transactions.description is partial: it keeps the first 2 characters of each word longer than 3 characters, keeps words of 3 characters or fewer whole, and for counterparty account numbers keeps the FIRST 2 digits, not the last 4. 'Last 4 digits' applies only to the client's own account label (account_ref) when it is taken from the file.
